notes: Limine boots its default entry, linux-cachyos-deckify, at every power-on (`oxp3-tool kernel try` turned remember_last_entry off; `sudo oxp3-tool kernel keep`, on the kernel to keep, puts it back)

log.text: - change `remember_last_entry: yes` to `remember_last_entry: no`: every power-on then boots Limine's default entry (in /boot/limine.conf)
- ask Limine for one boot of linux-cachyos-deckify-vsw (`bootctl set-oneshot CachyOS.linux-cachyos-deckify-vsw`)
Ready. Reboot when you like (`systemctl reboot`): Limine boots linux-cachyos-deckify-vsw once.

If it hangs or the screen stays dark, hold the power button for about 10 seconds until the device is off, then turn it on: Limine boots linux-cachyos-deckify after 5 seconds. Every reboot or power-on after that one boot goes back to linux-cachyos-deckify too.
On linux-cachyos-deckify-vsw, `uname -r` shows 7.2.11-1-cachyos-deckify-vsw. To keep booting it: `sudo oxp3-tool kernel keep`.
